claim.value: Changes to recording can produce apparent improvement without changing customer behavior.
claim.scope: A possible measurement explanation; the mapping does not identify a particular metric or observed instance.

rationale: Recorded outcomes depend on how events are linked and captured. Changing that process can improve the recorded picture while the underlying customer behavior remains constant. This licenses the stated possibility without establishing that it explains any observed improvement.
uncertainty: Whether recording changes actually account for an improvement remains unestablished; the claim asserts only that they can.
